description: This file defines the CatalogItem class, a model representing catalog items in an e-commerce web application. It includes properties for item details, validation logic, and image handling methods.

classes.name: CatalogItem
classes.description: A model class representing an item in the product catalog, including properties for item details and methods for image validation and conversion.

methods.name: IsValidImage
methods.description: Validates the image file based on name and base64 data, checking size and extension constraints.

methods.name: DataToBase64
methods.description: Converts an IFileListEntry (file upload) to a base64 string asynchronously.

methods.name: IsExtensionValid
methods.description: Checks if the file extension of the provided filename is among accepted image formats.
